description: This file contains functions and classes for transforming a PyTorch computational graph into a tensor parallel graph, including graph partitioning, sharding, and redistribution logic, specifically for distributed tensor operations.

classes.name: _TensorParallelTransformPass
classes.description: A class responsible for transforming a single-device graph into a tensor parallel graph, including marking sharding strategies, partitioning, and sharding parameters.

methods.name: tensor_parallel_transformation
methods.description: Main entry point to perform graph transformations, converting a single-device graph into a tensor parallel graph.

methods.name: _generate_parameter_and_buffer_placements
methods.description: Builds parameter placements based on parallel strategies for linear layers.

methods.name: _mark_tensor_parallel_shardings
methods.description: Marks the placement strategies for parameter and buffer nodes in the graph.

methods.name: _get_input_node_fqn
methods.description: Returns the fully qualified name (FQN) of an input node based on the graph signature.

methods.name: _mark_sharding
methods.description: Marks sharding strategies for each node in the graph, including handling of specific node types and op schemas.

methods.name: _get_output_spec_from_output_sharding
methods.description: Extracts output tensor specifications from output sharding information.

methods.name: _create_placement_strategy
methods.description: Constructs an OpSpec for a node, including tensor meta population.

methods.name: _populate_tensor_meta
methods.description: Populates tensor metadata for output specifications based on node metadata.

methods.name: _generate_default_output_sharding
methods.description: Creates a default output sharding configuration with replicate placement.

methods.name: _partitioner
methods.description: Partitions a graph module from single-device to distributed graph based on sharding metadata.

methods.name: _partition_val
methods.description: Converts a full tensor value to its local shard based on sharding specifications.

methods.name: _insert_reshard_gm
methods.description: Inserts redistribution operations into the graph for tensor redistribution.

methods.name: _clean_up_graph_metadata
methods.description: Removes sharding and partitioning metadata from the graph nodes.

methods.name: _get_input_node_specs
methods.description: Retrieves input tensor specifications for a node based on placement strategies.

methods.name: _get_op_schema
methods.description: Constructs an operator schema for a node based on placement strategies.

methods.name: _shard_state_dict
methods.description: Inplace partitions the model's state dict parameters according to sharding strategies.
